name: Scrap Rat
desc: A rat the size of a dog, grown fat on the insulation of dead ships.

intro: Something the size of a dog squeezes out of a torn duct, trailing chewed cable, and looks at your boots with interest.
You hear small claws in the wall beside you. Then a panel falls off, and they aren't small.
hit: It runs straight up your leg, and teeth made for shielded cable close on your arm.
Yellow teeth clamp on your calf, and it hangs on while you try to shake it off.
It drops on you from a conduit overhead, all claws and stink.
miss: It lunges for your ankle, and you kick it into the bulkhead.
Its teeth snap shut on your sleeve and come away with nothing but a mouthful of cloth.
It darts between your feet and out the other side, squealing at you.
crit: It gets in under your collar and goes for your throat, and for a moment all you can hear is squealing.
defeated: It flips onto its back at your feet, and its legs keep running for a while.
You stop it with your boot. Somewhere in the walls, a lot of small feet go quiet.
joins: {Enemy} squeezes out of a torn duct behind you and comes for your ankles.
stunned: {Enemy} shakes its head, staggers in a circle, and forgets about you.
calm_worked: You kick a length of old insulation toward it and walk the other way. The rat falls on it, and it forgets you ever existed.
